policy: CC0 only for recorded music: each page was checked to list CC0 among its licences, and the CC0 grant is the one Fog City relies on. Nothing that merely says 'free' or 'royalty-free' is used. The car radio's other tracks (origin "generated") are original work, composed note by note and synthesised in code by scripts/audio/compose-radio.ts: no sample, recording, cover or quotation of anyone else's music.

tracks.title: Midnight Cruiser
tracks.author: Zane Little Music
tracks.why: Lively jazz-funk fusion: a sunny, bouncy drive along the Embarcadero.

tracks.title: Electronic Outlaw
tracks.author: Zane Little Music
tracks.why: Driving electronic groove at about 136 BPM for walking and robot hunting on foot.

tracks.title: Down to Business
tracks.author: Zane Little Music
tracks.why: "Hard business 80's synth": the startup-satire mission bed.

tracks.title: Invincibility [Loop]
tracks.author: Zane Little Music
tracks.why: Short, frantic power-up loop for water-blaster fights with bad robots.

tracks.title: Midnight Drive
tracks.author: congusbongus
tracks.why: Upbeat synthwave (MilkyTracker) under the pause menu, phone and settings.

tracks.title: Seed Round Cypher
tracks.author: Fog City (composed and synthesised in code)
tracks.why: 90 BPM boom-bap in A minor: swung drums, an upright-style bass, chopped electric-piano chords through a sampler colour (tape wow, 24 kHz grit, crackle), a vibraphone hook.

tracks.title: Down Round Drip
tracks.author: Fog City (composed and synthesised in code)
tracks.why: 140 BPM half-time trap in C minor: gliding 808s, hat rolls in sixteenths, sextuplets and 32nds, a clap on three, a dark FM bell motif and a pad.

tracks.title: Outer Sunset Bounce
tracks.author: Fog City (composed and synthesised in code)
tracks.why: 96 BPM West Coast bounce in F minor: a sliding analogue bass, swung sixteenth hats, Rhodes-style comping and a high portamento whistle lead.

tracks.title: Up and to the Right
tracks.author: Fog City (composed and synthesised in code)
tracks.why: 122 BPM four-on-the-floor dance-pop in F major: sidechained supersaw chords, off-beat bass, a pluck arpeggio, a breakdown and a bright synth hook.

tracks.title: Demo Day Heart
tracks.author: Fog City (composed and synthesised in code)
tracks.why: 100 BPM half-time synth-pop in D major: a gated snare on three, pulsing eighth bass, a bright arpeggio, tom fills and a saw lead hook.

tracks.title: Lock-Up Period
tracks.author: Fog City (composed and synthesised in code)
tracks.why: 116 BPM nu-disco pop in E minor: four-on-the-floor, octave disco bass, clav stabs, strings and a brass-style lead hook.
